Setup / Steps: Get summary for a supplier that has 3 products
Expected Result: Supplier id and name filled in; product count = 3; total stock = sum of stock; total value = sum of (price x stock)

Scenario: Product list shows only this supplier's products
Setup / Steps: Get summary for a supplier; other suppliers also have products
Expected Result: List has each of this supplier's products with name and stock quantity; no other supplier's product appears

Setup / Steps: Increase stock of one product by 10; get summary
Expected Result: Total stock +10; total value increases by price x 10; product count unchanged

Setup / Steps: Decrease stock of one product by 5; get summary
Expected Result: Total stock -5; total value decreases by price x 5; product count unchanged

Setup / Steps: Create a new product for the supplier; get summary
Expected Result: Product count +1; new product appears in the list; totals include it

Setup / Steps: Delete one product of the supplier; get summary
Expected Result: Product count -1; deleted product not in list; totals exclude it

Setup / Steps: Update a product and change its supplier from A to B; get summary of A and B
Expected Result: A: count and totals go down, product gone from list. B: count and totals go up, product in list

Setup / Steps: Get summary for a supplier that exists but has no products
Expected Result: Success (not an error); count 0; total stock 0; total value 0; empty list

Setup / Steps: Supplier has one product with stock 0 and others with stock
Expected Result: Zero-stock product is still in the list with stock 0; it adds 0 to total stock and 0 to total value

Setup / Steps: Supplier whose products all have stock 0
Expected Result: Product count = number of products; total stock 0; total value 0; all products listed with stock 0

Setup / Steps: Reduce a product's stock by its full quantity; get summary
Expected Result: Product stays in the list with stock 0; total stock goes down by that quantity

Setup / Steps: Delete every product of the supplier; get summary
Expected Result: Success; count 0; total stock 0; total value 0; empty list

Setup / Steps: Get summary for a supplier with a single product
Expected Result: Count = 1; totals equal that product's stock and price x stock; list has one item
Total value is exact to 2 decimals; no rounding error

Setup / Steps: Get summary for supplier id 0 and -1
Reduce a product's stock by more than it has; get summary
Expected Result: Adjustment rejected as invalid; summary totals and list unchanged

Setup / Steps: Create a product with a supplier id that does not exist; get summary of existing suppliers
Expected Result: Create rejected as invalid; no supplier summary changes

Setup / Steps: Update a product with a supplier id that does not exist; get summary of its current supplier
Expected Result: Update rejected as invalid; current supplier's summary unchanged
